resourceGroup.description: The API group every generated CRD lands under: each resource kind plus a <Kind>Configuration auth kind for it.

kinds.description: Which kinds to render, by Kind name. Empty renders all 32. Each listed kind runs one controller pod, so a child that only publishes through the builders sets [Repository, PullRequest].

githubBaseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise API base URL (e.g. https://ghe.corp.example.com/api/v3, or https://api.<subdomain>.ghe.com). Empty means github.com. Requires oasgen-provider >= 0.52.0.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values (injected by the chart-inspector / when used as a subchart).
